items.followUp: State two observations A.F.A. King used to suggest a connection between mosquitoes and malaria.

rubric.why: Identifies the observed association between mosquito abundance and malaria.
rubric.description: States that malaria was common where mosquitoes were abundant.

rubric.why: Identifies the observation that protection from mosquitoes was associated with fewer cases of malaria.
rubric.description: States that people protected by mosquito nets had less malaria.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for this second observation.

modelAnswer: Malaria was common in places where mosquitoes were abundant.
People who slept under mosquito nets had less malaria.
